## Pull Request Checklist

Before submitting your pull request, please make sure you have gone through the following:

- [ ] I have self-reviewed my code.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works (if applicable).
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable).

## Pull Request Details

**Issue Number (if applicable):** [Link to the relevant issue, e.g., #123]

**Summary of Changes:**

[A concise summary of the changes introduced by this pull request. Be specific and explain what you've done.]

**Detailed Explanation of Changes:**

[Provide a more in-depth explanation of the changes. This can include the reasoning behind the changes, implementation details, and any challenges you faced.]

**Related Issues (if any):**

- [Link to related issue 1]
- [Link to related issue 2]

**Screenshots (if applicable):**

[If your changes involve UI modifications, please include before and after screenshots to illustrate the changes.]

**Testing Carried Out:**

[Describe the testing you performed to ensure the changes work as expected. Include the steps you took and any specific scenarios you tested.]

**Impact on Users:**

[Explain how these changes will affect users of Work Buddy. Will it introduce new features, fix bugs, or improve performance?]

**Additional Notes:**

[Any other relevant information that reviewers should be aware of, such as potential breaking changes, dependencies, or areas that might require extra attention.]
